interaction.prompt: You catch the puck in the high slot. Your pre-receive scan is done. Tap where the puck should go for the best chance.

feedback.right: Move it backdoor right away. The backdoor winger is sneaking in behind coverage, and a one-touch pass gets there before the goalie can push across.
feedback.wrong: The shot from the high slot is there, but the goalie is square and set with no screen or rebound traffic. It is a low-percentage shot. The backdoor winger is the better chance.

tip: Scan before the puck hits your tape. If a teammate is open behind the goalie's eyes, move it before settling.
why: Scanning before receiving lets the player choose the higher-value backdoor option in one touch instead of defaulting to a contested shot the goalie is already set for.
